````text
# #4985: Patch: follow-up to #4960 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #4960 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #4960 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45733504316)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`40d6f5966458`). `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #4960 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c188_overfitting.rs:60`: Overfitting's reveal gate behaves differently now, which the PR and issue both said would not happen, and no test covers the gate clause before or after the change.
  Evidence: The old clause was `units.iter().any(|pile| pile.is_none())`, which is true for any raw empty pile. The new clause is `!fill_board_zones(..).is_empty()`, and `fill_board_zones` (crates/engine/src/zones.rs:1856) keeps only slots where `takes_move` holds (zones.rs:462: `is_empty` && `!is_reserved`) and that are not `in_hole`. `is_empty` (zones.rs:213) also rejects a zone a GIGA covers and a voided zone. So when the only open unit zones on Overfitting's controller's side are reserved (a dying Reborn unit holding its zone per R64, or an animated card's home), in a hole, covered by a GIGA or voided, the old gate revealed the trap and the copy fizzled, but the new gate leaves the trap set. The new behavior agrees with where `summon_copy` with `lane: None` can actually land (effects/summon.rs:294, `entry_zone` → `first_entry_zone_where`), so it is probably the better rule. But it is a rules change, and nothing proves it. The file's only tests are `base::summons_copy_with_plus_2_plus_2` and `radiant::summons_radiant_copy_with_plus_2_plus_2`, both on an open board. No test anywhere checks a full board or a reserved-only board (grep for `infiniteassault-188` finds only this file), so deleting the whole fifth `&&` clause would also pass every test. Fix: add tests in the file's `mod tests` that pin the gate. (a) The opponent plays a Unit while every unit zone of Overfitting's controller is occupied: Overfitting stays face-down in the backrow. (b) The only empty unit zone is reserved, e.g

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

<!-- jackioh-bot -->

## Plan

_Written by `claude-1` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45735773678)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Pin Overfitting's reveal gate (`crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c188_overfitting.rs:60`, `!fill_board_zones(ctx.state, ctx.controller).is_empty()`) with tests. Today nothing fails if that clause is deleted. The gate changed in #4960 from "any raw empty pile" to "a unit zone a summon can actually take" (empty, unreserved, not covered by a GIGA, not voided, not in the hole). The issue calls that "probably the better rule" but unproven, so this item records it as a ruling and proves it:

- (a) With every unit zone of the controller occupied, the trap stays set.
- (b) With the only empty unit zone reserved, the trap stays set.
- (c) With the only empty unit zone in the open hole, the trap stays set.
- (d) With one open zone left beside a reserved one, the trap still reveals.

No behaviour changes, so the script's code is not edited.

## Files to touch

| File | Status | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c188_overfitting.rs` | change | Add tests only, inside `mod tests`, below the existing ones. Do NOT edit any line above `#[cfg(test)]`: the catalog's `loc` counts code above the tests, so `catalog.json` stays unchanged. |
| `spec/rulings/R4985000.md` | new | The ruling note (proven in the file above). |
| `spec/pending/4985.md` | new | The ruling's §11 paragraph. |

Governing spec: SPEC §8.13 row 188 (`spec/08-catalog/8.13-infinite-assault.md:217`), R64 (a reserved zone), R688 / `takes_move`, R3554000 (the hole), R4592000's block (Overfitting was built under #4592), and `spec/README.md` "Adding a ruling".

Do not touch: `crates/engine` and `crates/ai`, `crates/cards/catalog.json`, `crates/cards/patches/`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`, `spec/history/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

## Steps

1. Read `spec/README.md` "Adding a ruling" and one existing note (`spec/rulings/R4921000.md`) for the format.

2. Create `spec/rulings/R4985000.md`. Issue #4985 owns R4985000 to R4985999 and none exists yet, so take R4985000.
   - Frontmatter, in the format of `spec/rulings/R4921000.md`:
     ```
     ---
     id: R4985000
     title: "Overfitting stays set when no unit zone of its controller can take the copy (issue #4985; amends IA #188's gate)"
     cards: "§8.13, R64, R688, R3554000, R4592000, IA #188"
     proven_in:
       - crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c188_overfitting.rs
     ---
     ```
   - Body, short. Cover these points:
     - Overfitting reveals only if its controller has at least one unit zone `fill_board_zones` yields: empty, unreserved (R64's dying Reborn unit, an animated card's home), not covered by a GIGA, not voided, not in the hole.
     - Reason: `summon_copy` with no lane lands only in such a zone (`entry_zone`), so a reveal with none would fizzle and waste the trap. Hearthstone's secrets that summon (Mirror Entity, Snake Trap) likewise do not trigger on a full board.
     - Rejected: the raw "any empty pile" gate (#4960's predecessor), which revealed the trap and fizzled the copy.
     - The gate is read as the opponent's Unit resolves, before the trap reveals; a zone that opens up later does not matter.
     - Link `[[R64]]`, `[[R688]]`, `[[R3554000]]`, `[[R4592000]]`. Check each link target exists with `ls spec/rulings/`, and drop any that does not.

3. Create `spec/pending/4985.md` with one paragraph in the format of `spec/pending/4921.md`: `**[[R4985000]] Overfitting stays set when no unit zone can take its copy (issue #4985, 2026-11-26)**: asked by #4985, the after-merge spot-check of #4960, which found that #4960 changed IA #188's reveal gate without a ruling or a test. Edits §8.13's row 188 only in meaning (the note carries the rule). Takes R4985000.` Do not restate the note.

4. In `c188_overfitting.rs`, add the tests below to `mod tests`. Add no new `use` lines unless a name fails to resolve: `Row`, `PlayerId`, `Scenario`, `json!`, `active_units_of` and `reserve_zone` come through `jackioh_engine::testkit::*`, which re-exports the whole engine. If `Row` or `reserve_zone` fails to resolve, use `jackioh_engine::zones::{reserve_zone, ZoneSlot}` and the module that defines `Row` (c009_ticketed.rs, line 158, shows the usage).

   First add helpers inside `mod tests`:
   ```rust
   /// Overfitting set in p1's lane 1; p1's unit zones hold `held` stand-ins (lanes 1..=held);
   /// p2 holds the Unit to play.
   fn crowded(radiant: bool, held: usize) -> Scenario {
       let field: Vec<_> = (1..=held).map(|lane| json!({ "def": UNIT, "lane": lane })).collect();
       scenario(json!({
           "active": "p2",
           "p1": {
               "backrow": [{ "def": ID, "radiant": radiant, "faceUp": false, "lane": 1 }],
               "field": field,
               "mana": 10,
           },
           "p2": { "hand": [UNIT], "mana": 10 },
       }))
   }
   ```
   The unit zone count is `UNIT_ZONES = 5` (`crates/engine/src/config.rs:156`).

   Note: p2 plays `UNIT` into its own lane 1. This is p2's board, not p1's, so lane use on p1's side is unaffected. `play` with `json!({ "zone": 1 })` is the existing pattern.

   Then add `mod gate { use super::*; ... }` with these tests. All are `#[test]` and named after the ruling, so `spec check` finds them:

   - `r4985000_stays_set_when_every_unit_zone_is_occupied`: `crowded(false, 5)`; `s.play(UNIT, json!({ "zone": 1 }))`; `s.expect_in_zone(ID, "field")`; `assert_eq!(active_units_of(s.state(), P1).len(), 5)` (no copy summoned).
   - `r4985000_stays_set_when_the_only_empty_zone_is_reserved`: `crowded(false, 4)`; before playing, `reserve_zone(s.state_mut(), ZoneSlot { player: P1, row: Row::Units, lane: 5 })`, qualifying the path as above if needed; then play, `expect_in_zone(ID, "field")`, 4 units on P1's side.
   - `r4985000_stays_set_when_the_only_empty_zone_is_in_the_hole`: `crowded(false, 4)`; set `s.state_mut().black_hole = Some(jackioh_engine::geometry::BlackHole { lane: 5, swallowed: None, pulls: None, capacity: None, at_end: None })` (the struct fields as in `crates/engine/tests/rules/board_geometry.rs:214`). p2's play goes into lane 1, not the hole lane. Then play, `expect_in_zone(ID, "field")`, 4 units. If the testkit's `play` refuses because of the hole, move p2's `UNIT` play to lane 2 and keep the assertion.
   - `r4985000_reveals_while_an_open_zone_remains_beside_a_reserved_one`: `crowded(false, 3)`; reserve lane 5; play; `expect_in_zone(ID, "graveyard")`; the copy sits in lane 4 (`s.unit_at(P1, 4)`, `def_id == UNIT`, stats 3/3 via `expect_stats(&summoned, json!({ "attack": 3, "health": 3 }))`). This pins that the gate and `summon_copy` agree on the zone, and that a reserved zone is skipped rather than blocking the trap.
   - `r4985000_a_radiant_overfitting_obeys_the_same_gate`: `crowded(true, 5)`; play; `expect_in_zone(ID, "field")`.

   If lane 4 is not where the copy lands in the last test, trust the observed lane: read it with `active_units_of(s.state(), P1)`, and assert the lane differs from the reserved 5 and the occupied 1..=3. Do not weaken the assertion into a tautology.

5. Mutation check (manual, not committed). Temporarily replace `&& !fill_board_zones(ctx.state, ctx.controller).is_empty()` with `&& true` in the file, run `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c188_overfitting`, and confirm tests 1, 2, 3 and 5 fail. Then replace it with the old `ctx.state.players[ctx.controller].units.iter().any(|pile| pile.is_none())` and confirm tests 2 and 3 fail. Restore the line exactly, and confirm with `git diff` that the file has no change above `#[cfg(test)]`. If a test does not fail under its mutation, fix the test, not the code.

## Tests

All in `crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/c188_overfitting.rs`, `mod tests::gate`, as listed in step 4. The existing `base::summons_copy_with_plus_2_plus_2` and `radiant::summons_radiant_copy_with_plus_2_plus_2` stay unchanged.

Commands:
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c188_overfitting`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards r4985000`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `cargo jackioh catalog check` (must still pass with no `catalog.json` diff)
- `cargo jackioh patches check`

## Done when

- [ ] Tests (a) full board, (b) reserved-only, (c) hole-only and (d) open-beside-reserved exist, plus the Radiant case, each asserting its outcome, none ignored or weakened.
- [ ] Step 5's mutation check showed they fail without the gate clause.
- [ ] `spec/rulings/R4985000.md` and `spec/pending/4985.md` exist and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] The script file has no change above `#[cfg(test)]` and `catalog.json` has no diff.
- [ ] The harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy and cargo tests.

## Risks

- A catalog `loc` mismatch if the code above the tests is edited: only append to `mod tests`.
- `crowded` using `"field"` without a lane relies on explicit lanes, which the helper gives. Don't use bare strings there.
- Tests could pass vacuously if p1's play is refused. Assert the positive outcome (the unit count, or the trap's zone) as written, rather than only the absence of an event.
- The hole test may be sensitive to how the testkit handles `black_hole` at play time. The fallback is in step 4.
- Do not add a `#[allow]`, and do not use hash-ordered collections (rule 4 applies to this crate's tests too).

## Open questions

None. One decision is recorded in the ruling: keep #4960's stricter gate, which matches where the copy can land, and reject restoring the raw-empty-pile gate. The reasons are that the old gate wasted the trap on a fizzle, and that Hearthstone's summoning secrets don't trigger on a full board.
````
